title: Musquatax / Squorums Neck
summary: Musquatax names a creek on Mastic Neck in Brookhaven. The cited source places it within Unkechaug land-title geography and interprets the name as a rush-growing place.
history_content: Mastic Neck creek, nearby neck names, and rush-place interpretation are brought together here. Time-specific land-title context is handled as a Historic Moment.
translation_content:
Recorded forms and related names include Musquatax, Squorums, Waspeunk, and Squorums Neck. Squorums is treated as a personal-name neck form connected with the same Mastic Neck deed landscape.

Why Place Names Matter

“The naming of places is an important aspect of community identity and cultural heritage.”

— Brimbank City Council, Place Naming Policy (2023), Policy purpose, PDF page 2
whereintheworld_content: The point is an approximate general marker for the west side of Mastic Neck and nearby creek/wetland geography. It is not an exact deed boundary or surveyed creek-head location.
